name: Shiqu de Qunxing
source:
Probably as long as a place buries a corpse, it will really bind a living person.I would look back without hesitation, because when we walked together through the cold and wet mansion, I saw all the lives we spent together, and in the last moment, I chose to remember.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578860]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大概只要一个埋葬尸体的地方，就真的会束缚一个活人。我会毫不犹豫地回头，因为当我们一起走过寒冷潮湿的豪宅时，我看到了我们一起度过的所有人生，而在最后一刻，我选择了回忆。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578860]Steam[/url]]
